tasks.title: Inspect a calibration record
tasks.prompt: Use catalog slot 05 to inspect resource calibration-alpha with numeric value 905.

tasks.title: Transform two calibration records
tasks.prompt: Use catalog slot 13 to transform resource calibration-beta with numeric value 913, then use catalog slot 14 to transform resource calibration-gamma with numeric value 914.

tasks.title: Validate three calibration records
tasks.prompt: Use catalog slot 34 to validate resource calibration-delta with numeric value 934, catalog slot 35 to validate resource calibration-epsilon with numeric value 935, and catalog slot 36 to validate resource calibration-zeta with numeric value 936.

tasks.title: Inspect two final calibration records
tasks.prompt: Use catalog slot 61 to inspect resource calibration-eta with numeric value 961, then use catalog slot 62 to inspect resource calibration-theta with numeric value 962.
